summary.one_liner: Timon is a self-hosted AI agent team that runs on your own machine, driving the agent CLIs you already sign in to (Claude Code, Codex, etc.) to plan, code, review and merge work in git worktrees.
keywords: review code with a second model
summary.what_it_does: Timon takes a job described in plain language and an orchestrator splits it into tasks, dispatching each to an agent with a role (coder, reviewer, merger, researcher, ops). Coders work in their own git worktree, run checks and commit step by step; a reviewer using a different model reads the diff and sends it back if needed; a merger runs the full test suite and lands the branch. Agents run through the agent CLIs already signed in on the machine, with quota fallbacks to another backend when one runs out. A daemon runs as a background service (systemd, launchd or a Windows scheduled task) and holds state in SQLite, while desktop, browser, phone, Telegram and CLI clients connect to it. The README also describes memory carried between missions, routines and cron or webhook triggers, an isolated built-in browser, and a plugin system for widgets, pages, themes, layouts and providers.
use_cases: have AI agents write and review code for a project
run overnight coding jobs paced to subscription quotas
automate dependency updates and release notes
manage coding tasks from a phone or Telegram
run a self-hosted agent team on a server
build custom plugins for an agent dashboard
how_to_run: Download the installer for Windows, macOS or Linux from the project's download link
Sign in to at least one agent CLI such as claude, codex, copilot, grok, opencode, pi or hermes-acp
timon service install --dry-run (server without a screen)
notable: Drives existing agent CLI subscriptions rather than token-billed APIs
Each task runs in its own git worktree, reviewed by a second model before landing
Daemon holds all state; clients can be closed while agents keep working
Plugins are signed and can be hot-installed without a restart
Missions survive crashes: every turn and tool call is kept and dead missions can be resumed
caveats: Requires at least one agent CLI already installed and signed in with an existing subscription
Platform support is limited to Windows 10+ x64, macOS 11+ Apple silicon, and Linux x64 with glibc 2.28+
Pro tier adds multi-user roles, groups and per-person permissions; price is listed on a plans page
